# Snapport：英文 Shorts 腳本「在家拍 2×2 → 排 4×6 沖印版」（snapport-05）

| 項目 | 內容 |
|---|---|
| 用途 | 一支約 30 秒的英文直式影片，照實拍出：白牆前請別人拍 → 2×2 in 範本 → 頭頂／眼睛／下巴導引線 → 排成 4×6 in 沖印版（一頁多張、裁切線）→ 剪下。依報告，Snapport 的外宣連結一律導向免費的 Snapport Lite，所以**全片用 Snapport Lite 錄製**（2×2 範本、4×6 排版、第一次匯出免費都在 Lite listing 裡），付費版只在說明欄最後一句帶過 |
| 發在哪／給誰 | 店主本人的 YouTube Shorts（英文）；可同步 Instagram Reels、TikTok。觀眾：美國要換護照或辦其他需要 2×2 in 照片的人 |
| 發文者 | 店主 Guan Feng Lai 本人錄製並上傳；說明欄第一行寫明開發者身分 |
| 發文規則 | 每平台只發一次。連結放置頂留言（ct 見下），影片內不唸網址。畫面全部實機錄影，不剪接造假、不加美肌濾鏡。不出現其他 App、藥妝店或沖印店的名稱與招牌，不提第三方價格。留言不拉票、不以任何東西交換評分 |
| 事實依據（App） | snapportlite_full.json en-US：35 presets for 28 countries and regions incl. 2×2 in；on-device face detection with head-top, eye-line and chin guides；pinch, drag, rotate；keep original background or switch to white／light gray／blue／red／custom；gentle brightness／contrast／warmth／sharpness；export JPEG／PNG／PDF；print sheets on 4×6 in／A4／Letter with several copies and cut guides；processed on device, never uploaded, works offline；every preset and editing tool free, first export included, one-time unlock for unlimited exports；no subscription／ads／tracking／account；does not guarantee acceptance, not affiliated with any government。Live name「Snapport Lite: Take ID Photos」。50 interface languages, switch in-app（owner-confirmed）。付費版：snapport_full.json「Buy Snapport once… no in-app purchases」 |
| 事實依據（規定） | U.S. Department of State photo page（https://travel.state.gov/en/passports/apply/help/photos.html）：printed photo 2×2 in；head 1–1 3/8 in from bottom of chin to top of head；plain white or off-white background, no shadows on face or background；stand several feet from the wall。發布前把影片字幕的每個數字再對照一次該頁 |
| 不能拍／不能寫 | 真實護照、駕照；「accepted guaranteed」「government approved」「compliant」；任何價格比較；「best／#1」；美肌 |

## 錄製前準備

1. 模特兒：店主本人或已同意入鏡的家人，穿有顏色的上衣、不戴眼鏡。
2. 場地：白牆、白天面向窗戶，人離牆約 1 m，確認牆上沒有影子。
3. 第 2 鏡要拍到「另一個人用後鏡頭拍」：這是避免鏡像與變形最簡單的做法。
4. App 介面切到英文再錄。
5. 第 6 鏡：沖印版用家用印表機以**實際大小（100%）**印出 4×6 in 示範張即可；不拍沖印店。若印表機設定有「符合頁面／Fit to page」，要關掉，否則 2×2 會被縮放。
6. 第一次匯出免費：照實錄，不剪掉任何購買畫面。

## 說明欄（YouTube）

**Title**：2×2 passport-size photo at home → 4×6 print sheet

```text
I'm Guan Feng Lai, the developer of Snapport Lite. Every app screen in this video is a real recording.

What matters most for a 2×2 photo at home isn't the app:
1. A plain white or off-white wall, no shadows, window light from the front
2. Someone else takes the photo with the back camera, at eye level
3. No filters, no retouching

The U.S. State Department photo page asks for a 2×2 in print with the head 1 to 1 3/8 in from chin to top of head. Read the full rules at travel.state.gov before you submit.

Snapport Lite does the cropping: a 2×2 in preset (plus 34 others for 28 countries and regions, or your own size in mm, inches or pixels), head-top / eye-line / chin guides, then a JPEG or a 4×6 in print sheet with several copies and cut guides. Every preset and edit is free and your first export is free; a one-time unlock gives unlimited exports, no subscription. Photos are processed on your iPhone and never uploaded. 50 interface languages, switchable in the app.

It doesn't guarantee acceptance and isn't affiliated with any government.
If you'd rather buy a paid app with no in-app purchases, there's Snapport.
```
